bubbles.text: Once, the crown bound every banner beneath one promise: no kingdom would stand alone.

bubbles.speaker: THE KING
bubbles.text: While the crown endures, our people endure.
Then the Ash King came beneath a sky of fire.
He shattered the crown and armed four warlords with its fragments.

bubbles.speaker: ASH KING
bubbles.text: Let hope die chasing what it has lost.
One blue banner still refused to kneel.

bubbles.speaker: COMMANDER
bubbles.text: We are not chasing gold or glory. We are bringing every stolen home back with us.

bubbles.speaker: SCOUT
bubbles.text: Raiders crossed the Faded Field. Their arrows point north.

bubbles.speaker: COMMANDER
bubbles.text: Raise the banner. The road begins here.

level_001.title: The Faded Field
level_001.body: The Ash King's raiders burned the royal standard and vanished north with a shard of the crown. Hold the Faded Field—then follow the arrows waiting on the road ahead.
level_001.objective: Hold the Faded Field. Recover the four crown fragments. Defeat the Ash King.

level_002.title: First Arrows
level_002.body: Enemy archers have sealed the northern road, but one carries the first warlord's orders. Break their line and discover why every trail leads into the Silent Woodline.
level_002.objective: Break the archer line and recover the warlord's orders.

level_003.title: Silent Woodline
level_003.body: The Silent Woodline has swallowed every royal scout sent beneath its branches. At dusk, fresh hoofprints appear beside their abandoned banners—and they lead deeper into the forest.
level_003.objective: Find the lost scouts and follow the hoofprints.

level_004.title: Hoofbreak Trail
level_004.body: Enemy cavalry races along a broken trail, carrying the crown fragment toward an ancient grove. Stop the riders before they reach the warlord waiting beneath the oldest trees.
level_004.objective: Intercept the riders before they reach the grove.

level_005.title: Deep Forest Clash
level_005.body: The Forest Warlord makes his final stand around the first fragment. When the shard is reclaimed, its surface reveals a road drowned beneath black water.
level_005.objective: Defeat the Forest Warlord and reclaim the first fragment.

level_006.title: Mire Spear
level_006.body: Long spears guard every crossing through the flooded lowlands. Yet the soldiers are protecting more than a road—chains disappear into the fog beyond the mire.
level_006.objective: Break the spear guard and trace the chains through the fog.

level_007.title: Worker's Bog
level_007.body: The chains belong to captured villagers forced to feed the enemy war machine. Free them, and they may reveal what waits behind the shielded fortress across the bog.
level_007.objective: Free the captive villagers and secure the road.

level_008.title: Shield in the Mire
level_008.body: A shielded garrison seals the only causeway out of the mire. Its commander bears an iron sigil that grows warmer whenever thunder rolls beyond the mountains.
level_008.objective: Take the causeway and claim the iron sigil.

level_009.title: Thunder Approach
level_009.body: The iron sigil opens the road into Storm Valley, where lightning answers the warlord's horns. Before the climb begins, unseen archers take their positions above.
level_009.objective: Enter Storm Valley and survive the hidden archers.

level_010.title: Ranged Pressure
level_010.body: Archers command every ridge leading to the Iron Warlord's citadel. As the final bow falls silent, a forbidden flame rises from the tower ahead.
level_010.objective: Clear the ridges and reach the burning citadel.

level_011.title: First Flame of Magic
level_011.body: The Iron Warlord has awakened the second fragment's forbidden flame. Extinguish it—and learn why the shard shows a royal caravan dying far across the steppe.
level_011.objective: Defeat the Iron Warlord and reclaim the second fragment.

level_012.title: Cracked Provision
level_012.body: The royal caravan lies shattered, its provisions scattered across the steppe. Every surviving crate bears the same knife mark, and riders circle beyond the dust.
level_012.objective: Secure the provisions and identify the knife riders.

level_013.title: Fast Dust
level_013.body: Knife riders strike from the dust and vanish before the line can answer. One captured raider speaks of a black banner guarding the last road west.
level_013.objective: Defeat the knife riders and find the black banner.

level_014.title: Banner of the Last Road
level_014.body: The black banner marks the last defended road before the desert. Beyond it waits no army—only a trail of empty wells and footprints that end in open sand.
level_014.objective: Seize the last road and follow the desert trail.

level_015.title: Widening Desert
level_015.body: The final wells have been poisoned, and the desert widens without mercy. Beneath the dunes, hidden blades wait for anyone who follows the vanished tracks.
level_015.objective: Cross the poisoned desert and expose the hidden blades.

level_016.title: Needles in Sand
level_016.body: The Sand Warlord rises from the dunes with the third fragment and an army of hidden blades. When the shard is taken, it points toward a seal buried in eternal ice.
level_016.objective: Defeat the Sand Warlord and reclaim the third fragment.

level_017.title: Frozen Seal
level_017.body: The final fragment lies beyond the frozen pass, locked inside a seal no living mage can open. When the ice begins to crack, something ancient wakes behind the northern gate.
level_017.objective: Cross the frozen pass and break the ancient seal.

level_018.title: Long Winter Siege
level_018.body: The Winter Warlord has awakened and sealed the northern gate behind an endless siege. Defeat him, reunite the crown, and reveal the road hidden beneath its four fragments.
level_018.objective: Defeat the Winter Warlord and restore the crown.

level_019.title: Infernal Gate
level_019.body: The restored crown opens a road through fire to the Infernal Gate. Beyond it, the Ash King waits—and the crown begins to pulse as if it remembers the citadel.
level_019.objective: Open the Infernal Gate and reach the Ash Citadel.

level_020.title: Ash Citadel Final
level_020.body: Every fragment, every fallen banner, and every road has led to the Ash Citadel. Defeat the Ash King and return the restored crown to a realm that refused to kneel.
level_020.objective: Defeat the Ash King and restore the realm.
